summary: Comprehensive testing of FinanceFocus mobile Expo app completed. Backend: 100% pass rate (40/40 tests). Frontend: All core flows working correctly with minor testID issues.

issues: shadow* style props deprecated warning in console (use boxShadow instead)

react_native_issues.issue: TabIcon component creates duplicate testIDs because both focused and unfocused states render with same testID. First element (unfocused) may not be visible, causing Playwright clicks to fail.
react_native_issues.workaround: Use text-based selectors (text=Activity, text=Insights, etc.) which work correctly

action_items: Optional: Fix duplicate testID issue in TabIcon component by using unique IDs for focused/unfocused states
Optional: Replace deprecated shadow* props with boxShadow in theme.ts

✅ Environment variables used correctly (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, JWT_SECRET, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY)
✅ Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for API calls

✅ All text wrapped in Text component
